newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil lets Santander raise stake in Banco Geral.
newsitem.headline: Brazil lets Santander raise stake in Banco Geral.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council (CMN) Thursday authorized Banco Santander to raise its stake in Brazilian bank Banco Geral do Comercio, said Alkimar Moura, Central Bank Director of Controls.
Alkimar said Santander sought a 50.01 percent stake in the bank, of which the chief shareholder currently is Brazilian construction company Camargo Correa.
Alkimar said the Spanish bank wanted to run Banco Geral do Comercio as a retail bank.
Santander already had a stake in the bank, but the percentage was not disclosed.
The National Monetary Council sent a resolution authorizing the increase in Santander's stake to President Fernando Henrique Cardoso to be signed.
